chronic hypoxia depresses the vascular smooth muscle of the cerebral arteries of the fetus to a greater extent than the adult, and the endothelial function of the adult to a greater extent.

hypoxia depresses both smooth muscle and endothelium function to a greater degree in fetal than in mature cerebral arteries.
